crew.overview: When Sarah is forced to babysit her half-brother Toby, she inadvertently summons the Goblin King who whisks Toby away to his castle at the center of a labyrinth. Sarah enters into a bargain with the Goblin King where she is given just thirteen hours to solve the labyrinth and rescue Toby, or else lose him forever.
crew.title: Labyrinth

details.biography: Dennis Beynon Lee (born August 31, 1939) is a Canadian poet, teacher, editor, and critic. He is also a children's writer, well known for his book of children's rhymes, Alligator Pie.
details.name: Dennis Lee
